review_scope: Selected eclipse interpretation in hash-verified cached QLP SAP, with bounded follow-up where decisive.
evidence: Across 21 sectors the many dip and bright flags sit on long curved ramps and sharp orbit-edge steps. Examples include the S55 2809.11 dip before the 2809.907–2810.949 d gap, S58 2895.72 dip beside a 2896.021–2896.317 d discontinuity, S83 3571.39 dip before 3571.677–3571.955 d gap, and S84 3603.91 beside 3603.975–3604.195 d gap. Shapes and baseline levels change greatly between sectors.
interpretation: The selected eclipse interpretation is refuted by repeated positive gap/step/ramp context, without a stable isolated eclipse profile.
limitations: The numerous flags do not give a physical clock or depth; this does not globally exclude binarity.
catalogue_status: UNKNOWN; VSX, ASAS-SN, Kostov table 3/4 unavailable
